trade-sell.title: Stored goods sold where a station bid stands: each ship sells its own stores, nothing bought
trade-sell.note: 2026-11-17 19:42 UTC (Mercury, orders ENT-042): null matter leads: the Central Nexus bid read 200 to 210 cr for 7 to 295 units six times from 17:56 to 19:38 UTC (ledger.py prices null_matter), the only null matter bid in our books; floor 200 against Central Nexus' own ask of 213 to 220; carry-null-matter-beta-to-nexus and sell-null-matter-at-nexus are one-ship tests, carry-null-matter-synchrony-nexus is Mining's route, not claimed, one ship. Then soma 320 (cheapest ask 275 x 200,627 at Central Nexus; bids 342 to 343 x 5 to 17 at four stations), palladium 270 (cheapest ask 200 x 1; bid 548 x 2 at Synchrony Hub), hydrogen 30 (no home bid at 19:33 UTC). Every route gated by requires.stored and requires.bid; open to every division's ships (rule F24). Starter hull, no module.

trade-craft.title: Make from the pilot's own stores where they lie: copper piping, steel plate, then copper wiring
trade-craft.note: 2026-11-17 23:41 UTC (Mercury, orders.log ENT-052 block MERCURY, requests.log ENT-256): the reserve's iron is met, so a trader without a paying trade makes before it gathers: piping and plate for the reserve first, then wiring from surplus copper; the -own- routes use up a pilot's stores at a station in one visit.

trade-train-nav.title: Navigation trained to 3 on a loop of our five stations, for Signal Fragments (7,000 cr once)
trade-train-nav.note: requires.skills_below navigation 3: the route closes by itself at navigation 3, and Signal Fragments in the list First takes the pilot. About 4 navigation XP a jump, a loop of 17 to 18 minutes for about 165 cr of fuel.
